value.rationale: The primary recent paper posed and bounded precisely this determinant but stopped its sharp second inequality at the natural parameter threshold 2/3 while its first determinant held for all orders. The explicit gap 2/3<alpha<1 is structural, not an arbitrary parameter slice: completing it shows no new extremizer or transition as the starlikeness order approaches 1. The full-parameter estimate is sharp, has unique analytic extremals, and extends immediately to all radial Banach-ball maps, thereby completing an explicitly partial sharp inequality rather than furnishing a minor numeric constant improvement.
